error.name: KRON_SYS_OPENFAIL
error.text: The file could not be opened.

error.name: KRON_SYS_IOERR
error.text: The file opened but could not be read.

error.name: KRON_SYS_ABSENT
error.text: No CPU thermal zone was found — no /sys/class/thermal zone reports a usable temperature, or this is not Linux. TEMP is left at 0.0.

error.name: KRON_SYS_IOERR
error.text: A thermal zone was found but its value could not be read or parsed.

error.name: KRON_SYS_ABSENT
error.text: /proc/loadavg is not available — this is not Linux. The load outputs are left at 0.

error.name: KRON_SYS_IOERR
error.text: /proc/loadavg was read but did not yield the expected load figures.

error.name: KRON_SYS_ABSENT
error.text: statvfs is not available on this platform (Windows) — the simulation runs, but the disk figures stay 0.

error.name: KRON_SYS_IOERR
error.text: statvfs failed for PATH — the path does not exist, or it is not on a mounted filesystem.

error.name: KRON_SYS_OPENFAIL
error.text: PATH does not open as a file: it is missing, it is a directory, or the runtime has no permission to read it. Check the exact path on the target.

error.name: KRON_SYS_IOERR
error.text: The file opened but is empty — VALUE is an empty string. Some sysfs attributes only produce a value once the device is active.

error.name: KRON_SYS_ABSENT
error.text: No hwmon device carries NAME (or this is not Linux). The device is matched by its `name` attribute, not by the hwmonN index — that index is probe order and moves across boots.

error.name: KRON_SYS_OPENFAIL
error.text: The device was found but ATTR does not open on it — check the attribute name against `ls /sys/class/hwmon/hwmonN/`.

error.name: KRON_SYS_IOERR
error.text: The attribute opened but is empty — VALUE is an empty string.
